audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has his Q and E swapped — it calls the stun 'his E stun' and the engage 'Q-dash' in eight separate strings.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is the Q: he gains speed toward enemies and stuns the first one he attacks. Sky Splitter is the E: a lightning bolt that slows and shields him if he stands in the blast. The full layer already names Thundering Smash correctly, so the two layers contradicted each other.
audit.corrected: Every stun reference now says Thundering Smash (Q) and the shield now correctly belongs to Sky Splitter (E), matching the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were gated on 'his W heal' with no timer, and the passive was described as a 'third-hit lightning auto'.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul is a 5-second cooldown that only heals when he re-hits the SAME marked target — so the heal is a two-cast pattern you can break, not a passive drip. The Relentless Storm stacks attack speed and eventually adds bonus magic damage on his attacks; Riot's text has no third-hit trigger.
audit.corrected: Frenzied Maul's 5s and its same-target requirement now appear in the spikes; the passive is described as Riot describes it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sky Splitter's self-shield was absent entirely, and nothing said what Twilight Shroud does to the Frenzied Maul mark.
audit.why: Sky Splitter shields him if he is inside the blast radius, which is what absorbs the front of your burst. And because Frenzied Maul must re-hit the marked target to heal, going unselectable in Shroud denies the second bite outright.
audit.corrected: Added the Sky Splitter shield to the late-game and cooldown text, and the shroud-denies-the-second-bite interaction to the mid-game.

edits.before: He out-stats you here — his W bite heals him and his passive's third-hit lightning auto chunks you while you have only Q and no Shroud to disengage. Soak XP at Q range, don't auto-trade into his sustain.
edits.after: He out-stats you here — Frenzied Maul (W) heals him on the second bite of the same target and his passive stacks attack speed into bonus magic damage, while you have only Q and no Shroud. Soak XP at Q range.

edits.after: R online: bait or Shroud his Thundering Smash (Q) stun, then E-in and double-cast R — the second dash executes on his missing HP before Frenzied Maul's heal lands.

edits.before: This is where the lane turns yours. Once you have all three basics, Shroud blanks his commit — drop it the instant he Q-dashes in so his follow-up autos and W bite whiff, then come out and punish with your move-speed empowered auto. At 6 you take over: bait the E stun (or Shroud through its cast), then E-in and double-cast R to execute him on his missing health before his W heal resets the brawl. The whole fight is timing your Shroud and dodge to his E — if you commit before he uses it, he stuns you out of your own combo.
edits.after: This is where the lane turns yours. Once you have all three basics, Shroud blanks his commit — drop it the instant he Thundering-Smashes in, and because Frenzied Maul only heals on the second bite of the same target, being unselectable denies that heal entirely. Come out and punish with your move-speed empowered attack. At 6 you take over: bait the stun or Shroud through it, then E-in and double-cast R to execute on his missing health. The whole fight is timing your Shroud to his Q — commit before he spends it and he stuns you out of your own combo.

edits.after: Frenzied Maul heals on his second bite and his passive stacks attack speed into bonus magic damage, while you have only Q and no Shroud yet.

edits.after: With all three basics your Shroud blanks his Thundering Smash commit and your empowered-attack move speed dictates the trade.

edits.after: Shroud resets every trade Frenzied Maul tries to win — unselectable, he cannot re-bite the mark to heal off you.

notes: The content layer had Volibear's Q and E swapped throughout — 'E stun' and 'Q-dash' — while the full layer correctly identified Thundering Smash as the Q. Also removed the invented 'third-hit lightning auto' reading of The Relentless Storm. New interaction added: Frenzied Maul heals only when he re-hits the same marked target, so Twilight Shroud's unselectability denies the heal, not just the damage.
